features: FIND YOUR PERFECT FIT - Gabit Smart Ring sizes are unique and don’t match standard ring sizes. Start by ordering our Sizing Kit to ensure the perfect fit. Our rings come in sizes ranging from 6 to 13
TRY BEFORE YOU BUY - Use the Gabit Ring Sizing Kit to determine your accurate size. Wear the sizing ring for at least 24 hours to find the most comfortable fit.

PICK THE RIGHT FINGER - For ideal comfort and enhanced sleep tracking, we recommend wearing your Gabit Ring on your index finger. To guarantee the best tracking accuracy and comfort, the ring should fit snugly but not rotate freely when you move it on your finger.

ORDER YOUR SMART RING - After confirming your size with the Gabit Sizing Kit, you're ready to purchase your Gabit Smart Ring. For any queries, please reach out to us via contact details mentioned on Gabit website. We’d love to connect and we’ll assist you promptly.
description: GABIT RING SIZING KIT: Try the sample rings & know the best size for you. NOT STANDARD SIZING - Gabit Smart Ring sizes are different from standard ring sizes, so it is important to size yourself using our sizing kit and to follow the instructions provided. Gabit Ring is available in sizes 6-13. There are no half sizes. HOW IT SHOULD FIT - We recommend wearing your ring sizer for at least 24 hours to confirm your best fit. Gabit Smart Ring should fit securely and comfortably at the base of your finger. Your ring should not rotate as you go about normal daily tasks. For any queries, please reach out to us via contact details mentioned on Gabit website. We’d love to connect and we’ll assist you promptly. CHOOSE A FINGER - Gabit Smart Ring works on all fingers and can be worn on either hand. For optimal accuracy, we recommend wearing your Gabit Ring on your index finger.
